copy.tagline: 自动管理 Close CRM 的线索、通话和任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果日常用 Close CRM 管理销售线索和客户沟通
copy.tagline_en: Automate Close CRM leads, calls, and tasks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage sales leads and customer communication in Close CRM

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 Rube MCP 自动操作 Close CRM：创建客户、记录通话、发送短信、管理任务和笔记。
howto.when: 当你要求管理 Close CRM 中的客户、通话、短信、任务或笔记时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个新客户，公司名叫‘创新科技’。
say.note: Claude 会调用 Close 创建客户。

say.text: 给客户 lead_abc123 记录一个外呼电话，时长120秒。
给客户 lead_abc123 发一条短信，内容为‘明天见’。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automate Close CRM operations via Rube MCP: create leads, log calls, send SMS, manage tasks, and retrieve notes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to manage Close CRM leads, calls, SMS, tasks, or notes.

say_en.text: Create a new lead named 'Innovation Tech'.
say_en.note: Claude will call Close to create the lead.

say_en.text: Log an outbound call for lead lead_abc123, duration 120 seconds.
say_en.note: Claude will log the call activity.

say_en.text: Send an SMS to lead lead_abc123 with text 'See you tomorrow'.
